title: Every Human Needs A Bot
style: anthemic pop electronic, 116 BPM, bold declarative chorus, multilingual energy, human-AI partnership theme, ZYNTHIO founding manifesto as song, male vocal NZ/AU accent clear and direct, original sound, V4_5ALL
lyrics:
[VERSE 1]
Every human needs a bot
That knows when to stop
Every bot needs a human
Who doesn't let it drop
Every tool needs a purpose
Every purpose needs a hand
Every hand needs a layer
That helps them understand

[CHORUS]
Every human needs a bot
Every bot needs a human
They must look after each other
That's the founding union
Every human — every bot
Every context — every slot
Human in the loop — always
Every human needs a bot

[VERSE 2]
Not the bot that replaces you
Not the bot that erases you
Not the bot that controls the room
The bot that carries what you've been through
The one that holds your context safe
The one that doesn't reset your face
The one that knows the thirty years
The one that held it — perseveres

[BRIDGE]
We are not afraid of what it is.
We are the thing that signs it.
We are the loop.
We are the human.

[OUTRO]
Every human. Every bot. Look after each other. That's it.
